Subject: Redwood: prehire training and background checks - GreenFin scope

Hi Dylan —

As part of our SOC 2 readiness check for GreenFin's integration, TruAudit needs a small bundle of personnel evidence focused on onboarding/offboarding and training. To scope this precisely, can you provide the following for the sample population (3 hires + 2 leavers identified by GreenFin):

- Completed security awareness training transcripts or certificates (Q1–Q2 2027)
- Redacted background check confirmations (name + verification result + verification date; please remove SSNs and DOBs)
- Onboarding checklist records (first-day tasks completed, MSA/NDAs signed)
- Deprovisioning tickets and timing for the two leavers (ticket IDs or screenshots OK)
- SSO and provisioning audit snippet showing that access was removed within SLA
- Any employee attestations or training acknowledgement DocuSign links

We prefer delivery via a secure, access-controlled Drive folder and a single zip for archival. If anything is controlled (PII), note your redaction approach. Target needed by EOD Thursday 2027-06-10 to keep the audit window on schedule.

Thanks — please let me know if you need a narrower sample or a template for attestations.

Best,
Sara Lin
Senior Auditor, TruAudit
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
